entries.summary: Reconnect accessory taps your game's reconnect control for you. It is off by default. Turn it on in Settings > Menus. It needs the screen helper.
Reconnect checks run once a minute, only while the screen is on and the game is in front. After failed checks, the app waits longer, up to 5 minutes.
After 3 failed reconnect runs in a row, the app sends a notice. The notice clears itself once the accessory is back.
If the game is in front but the reconnect control is not found, you get one notice, not one per check.
Reconnect taps pause while the Tap to Walk overlay is on screen.
A failed check no longer stops the reconnect loop.
Settings now shows when the last check ran and what it found, under the Reconnect switch.
A share icon on the map, floating map and long-press sheet copies coordinates or shares a link to a location. It replaces the Share this location button.
Map buttons and sheets have a quieter look. A speed strip shows at the top left while spoofing.
The first point you add to a walk continues from your current position, not from the walk's start.
Switching the map style now takes effect on every map screen right away, without closing and reopening the screen.
Pick your game during first setup. It only hides features you do not need, such as Planting, Tap to Walk and Reconnect accessory. Change it any time in Settings > General > Game setup.
Settings > Menus is split in two. Theme, map source, place search, privacy, capture and debug now live in a new General page. Every option is still there.
Save and Discard buttons no longer cover the last settings entries.
The speed warning uses the unit you picked in Settings.
The route jump buttons and the altitude override button now live in Settings > Menus.

Tap to Walk now learns your game's map by itself while you walk. If you turn or zoom the game map, the app notices as you walk and adjusts. With no map learned yet, your first tap starts a short walk with a Cancel button in the notification, then walks to the spot you tapped.
The screen helper now takes a picture about every 3 seconds only while you walk in the game with Tap to Walk on. It takes none when the game is not in front.
The screen helper now says in its description, in setup and in Settings that it takes pictures only while Pokémon GO is on your screen.
The accessibility helper is now called locationjoystick screen helper. After updating, turn it on again in Android Accessibility settings.
Turning on Tap to Walk saves at once. The switch stays on after you accept the disclosure.
Planting has a new Expand only option. It walks the spiral out to the end radius once and stops, instead of expanding and tightening. Find it in Settings > Roaming and in the roaming sheet.
Planting has settings for the circle radius and the spacing between rings.
Planting now works with any route style. Turn it on when you paste coordinates, or in a route's detail screen, and pick the circle size. The start sheet shows it ticked for that route.
Paste coordinates can build a teleport route. Each stop has its own wait time. The option is hidden when Hide teleport features is on.
You can add a favorite as a stop when you build a route.
Saved routes are grouped, and you can sort them.
Looping routes no longer jump back to the start. They walk the closing leg to the first point.
With Hide teleport features on, teleport routes now walk between their points instead of jumping.
Moving between route stops no longer counts as a teleport, so it does not restart the teleport cooldown.
The teleport delay field in the start sheet fits on its own row.
After you steer with the joystick, Resume continues from where you steered, not from where you paused.
While spoofing, tapping a favorite offers Teleport, Walk, or Walk via roads.
Saved favorites are grouped, and you can sort them.
Place search now tries a second service when the first one fails. A service that has just failed is skipped for ten minutes.
You can now pick an app to open after the app handles a map link. Set it in Settings > General > Capture. It opens after you teleport or walk to the link's point.
Capture asks for confirmation before it clears the points you collected.
Controls now show their state by color. They are grey when idle, green when moving, and orange when a walk, route, or roam is paused.
Starting a roam, walk, teleport, or route from the floating widget no longer sends this app to the background. The app you are using stays in front.
The floating widget starts at 40% of screen height, so it does not shift when it expands.
The floating widget no longer keeps background work running after it closes.
The cooldown message and its badge now show in the app's supported languages instead of only English.
Buttons, cards and sheets across the app have a flatter look, with thin borders instead of shadows.
On Android 14 and newer, the app no longer crashes when location permission is missing.
When mock location stops, the app shows the error. Your real location no longer reaches other apps in that case.
Status and navigation bar icons follow the app's theme.
Position jitter eases toward a smaller radius instead of jumping.
When a leader is on your Wi-Fi, you can tap Join once. The app never joins a group by itself.
The sync QR code holds only your local Wi-Fi address. Followers refuse leaders that are not on your local network.
Leader mode starts only once. Finding a leader twice no longer crashes the app.
Leaving a group stops the search for the old group.
A follower you moved by hand goes back to following the leader after 30 seconds of idle time.
Screen readers announce the back arrow as Navigate up, not Open navigation menu.
Settings skips the disclosure dialogs once you accept. If consent was never recorded, the full disclosure shows again.
The Accept and Decline buttons stay in view while the disclosure text scrolls.
On a fresh install, setup starts with the accessibility disclosure. Its features stay off until you turn them on. The app works if you decline.
If you deny location permission for good, setup opens app settings so you can allow it.
Export and import now include your app settings, such as Tap to Walk, Reconnect accessory and theme.
Import applies all or nothing. If one entry fails, your data stays as it was.
Import rejects files that are not backups and files that are too large. Your data is not changed.
Import rejects GPX and backup coordinates that are not valid numbers or are out of range.
Map links with a place name no longer open at 0, 0.
Completion messages, the QR chooser and GPX import errors now show in your language.
The Control API rejects invalid roam settings and oversized requests.
